metadata.evidence_status: official API metadata retrieved today; consumer assertions are not independently adjudicated
metadata.selection: five most recent API results received on 2026-10-09, using the documented API query date fields; not random or representative
metadata.observation_date_basis: date_received as supplied by the source; timestamps include UTC offset Z
metadata.privacy: Only public categorical complaint metadata. Narratives, state, ZIP, tags, and individual consumer identifiers are excluded.
metadata.use: ingestion, schema, and lineage exercises only; no ETISE severity, routing, ground-truth answer, or quality labels
metadata.reproduction_limit: The live API may change. Response hash records the captured response; the full response is not redistributed. Retained categorical records are the versioned artifact.
metadata.terms: Review CFPB data-use notices before reuse. Public complaint assertions are not verified facts about the named companies.
